item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q015_artifact_tag_not_homology","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, d1a14h2 (1a14 chain H residues 1–8; SUNID 343393) is a synthetic N-terminal tag in the artifact class: class l “Artifacts,” fold l.1 “Tags,” superfamily l.1.1 “Tags,” and family l.1.1.1 “Tags.” It is not a biological protein domain, so sequence or structural similarity to it must not be treated as evidence of common ancestry, used for function transfer, or used as a biological template. By contrast, d1a14h1 (residues 9–111) is the biological immunoglobulin heavy-chain variable domain in family b.1.1.1, superfamily b.1.1. The apparent SCOPe fold/superfamily/family hierarchy assigned to d1a14h2 is an artifact taxonomy and carries no homology implication.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_domains — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h1, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h1/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h1/homology, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h2, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h2/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h2/homology","mcp__scope__get_scop_chain — /api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1a14H"]}]}
